info.name: NGINX Plus REST Stream Keyvals API
info.description: NGINX Plus REST API provides access to NGINX Plus status information, on-the-fly configuration of upstream servers and key-value pairs management for http and stream.

item.name: NGINX Return Key-Value Pairs from a Stream Keyval Zone

query.description: Get a particular key-value pair from the stream keyval zone.

variable.description: (Required) The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

request.description: Returns key-value pairs stored in a particular stream keyval shared memory zone.

query.description: Get a particular key-value pair from the stream keyval zone.

Keyval not found (*KeyvalNotFound*),

item.name: NGINX Add a Key-Value Pair to the Stream Keyval Zone

variable.description: (Required) The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

request.description: Adds a new key-value pair to the stream keyval shared memory zone. Several key-value pairs can be entered if the stream keyval shared memory zone is empty.

response.name:
Invalid JSON (*KeyvalFormatError*),
invalid key format (*KeyvalFormatError*),
key required (*KeyvalFormatError*),
keyval timeout is not enabled (*KeyvalFormatError*),
only one key can be added (*KeyvalFormatError*),
reading request body failed *BodyReadEr

item.name: NGINX Modify a Key-Value or Delete a Key

variable.description: (Required) The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

request.description: Changes the value of the selected key in the key-value pair, deletes a key by setting the key value to null, changes expiration time of a key-value pair. If synchronization of keyval zones in a cluster is enabled, deletes a key only on a target cluster node. Expiration time is specified in milliseconds with the *expire* parameter which overrides the *timeout* parameter of the keyval_zone directive.

response.name:
Invalid JSON (*KeyvalFormatError*),
key required (*KeyvalFormatError*),
keyval timeout is not enabled (*KeyvalFormatError*),
only one key can be updated (*KeyvalFormatError*),
reading request body failed *BodyReadError*)

Keyval not found (*KeyvalNotFound*),
keyval key not found (*KeyvalKeyNotFound*),
unknown version (*UnknownVersion*)

item.name: NGINX Empty the Stream Keyval Zone

variable.description: (Required) The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

request.description: Deletes all key-value pairs from the stream keyval shared memory zone. If synchronization of keyval zones in a cluster is enabled, empties the keyval zone only on a target cluster node.
